$Comment: The weekly warrant for essence: a cask of Life essence drawn out of gear over a week. STATION_OUTPUT on the exact essence id, qualified to the tables, so essence from a farm or the Sawmill does not count. It hangs on the Weekly board's hard band, which that board gates through its own AcceptRequires, so nothing about who may take it is written here beyond the stations feature. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Weekly board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
